headline.en: UNI trades 38% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor while still net inflationary — the burn narrative isn't working yet.
headline.zh: UNI 现价 $3.69, 较 DAO 自身 $5.96 回购基准低 38%, 且供给端仍净通胀, 销毁叙事尚未兑现。

keyChanges.en: Annualized buyback of $5.72M vs 20M UNI emissions (~$73.7M at spot) — burn covers only 7.8% of new supply, leaving net inflation at +2.07%/yr.
keyChanges.zh: 年化 buyback $5.72M 对 20M UNI 增发(现价约 $73.7M), 覆盖率仅 7.8%, 净通胀 +2.07%/年。

keyChanges.en: Long/short account ratio 2.15 with funding flat at +0.01% and OI of only $19.29M — retail over-positioned long into a market with no institutional confirmation.
keyChanges.zh: 多空账户比 2.15, funding rate 仅 +0.01%, OI 仅 $19.29M — 散户单边偏多, 但无机构接盘迹象。

keyChanges.en: Governance pipeline activating: three simultaneous fee-expansion temp checks (v4 Protocol Fees, Robinhood Chain, v4 activation) — first real revenue-side catalysts post-UNIfication.
keyChanges.zh: 治理管线首次活跃: v4 Protocol Fees、Robinhood Chain、v4 activation 三个 temp check 同时推进, 是 UNIfication 之后首批实质收入侧催化剂。

contrarianObservation.en: The bear case assumes governance stays slow, but three fee-expansion proposals are live at once. If even two pass and Unichain/v4 fees stack, annualized revenue could double and flip the emission math — a smart long is front-running that governance clustering, not the tape.
contrarianObservation.zh: 空头逻辑假设治理照旧拖沓, 但当前三项收费扩张提案同步推进。若任二通过并叠加 Unichain 与 v4 收入, 年化协议收入有望翻倍, 直接改写增发/销毁公式 — 聪明多头押的是治理集群, 不是盘面。

watchNext.en: Vote outcomes on v4 Protocol Fees + Robinhood Chain temp checks — direct inputs to the burn/emission ratio.
watchNext.zh: v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain temp check 的投票结果 — 直接影响销毁/增发比。

watchNext.en: Any progression of the real-yield RFC (buyback → stakers). Silent snapshot today, but this is the regime-shift variable.
watchNext.zh: real-yield RFC (buyback 转向 stakers 分配) 的最新进展 — 今日快照未提及, 但这是真正的 regime 切换变量。

watchNext.en: 24h volume normalization above $10M — current $1.93M (<0.1% of market cap) reads as apathy, not accumulation.
watchNext.zh: 日均成交回升至 $10M 以上 — 当前 $1.93M (不足市值 0.1%) 属冷清而非吸筹。

fullReasoning.en: UNI at $3.69 sits 38% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn anchor and inside historical retail capitulation. The structural problem hasn't moved: $33.63M annualized protocol revenue produces only $5.72M of buybacks against 20M UNI in emissions — 7.8% coverage, +2.07% net inflation. That is why every bullish headline fails to hold a bid. Derivatives confirm the read: $19.29M OI is trivial for a $2.3B cap, funding is flat at +0.01%, and a 2.15 long/short ratio means retail is over-positioned long without institutional confirmation. Daily volume of $1.93M — under 0.1% of market cap — is apathy, not accumulation. What prevents an outright short call is the governance pipeline: three simultaneous fee-expansion temp checks are the first credible revenue-side catalysts since UNIfication. If any pass, the burn/emission math changes materially. But temp checks are not on-chain votes and the market has learned to discount Uniswap governance timelines. Critical missing input: no update on the real-yield RFC, the actual regime-shift variable per our framework. Until burn coverage crosses 100% of emissions, or governance ships something on-chain, tape stays heavy. Trade it accordingly: fade rallies into $4.20-4.50, respect $3.30 as the last capitulation shelf before a $3 print.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 现价 $3.69, 较 DAO 自身 $5.96 回购基准低 38%, 落入历史散户投降区间。结构性问题没有改善: 年化协议收入 $33.63M 仅产生 $5.72M buyback, 对应 20M UNI 年度增发, 覆盖率仅 7.8%, 净通胀 +2.07%/年 — 这正是每次利好都守不住的根本原因。衍生品端印证疲弱: OI 仅 $19.29M, 对 $2.3B 市值而言微不足道; funding rate +0.01% 近乎归零; 多空账户比 2.15 意味着散户单边偏多, 但机构未接棒。日均成交 $1.93M, 不足市值 0.1%, 是冷清而非吸筹。当前唯一制约不直接看空的因素, 是治理端管线首次同步活跃: v4 Protocol Fees、Robinhood Chain、v4 activation 三个 temp check 并行推进, 是 UNIfication 后首批实质性的收入侧催化剂。任一通过, 销毁/增发比即可能显著改善。但 temp check 非链上投票, 市场早已给 Uniswap 治理节奏打折扣。关键数据缺口: real-yield RFC 无最新进展, 而这才是我们框架中真正的 regime 切换变量。在 buyback 覆盖率突破 100%、或治理有链上落地之前, 走势维持偏弱。策略上: $4.20-4.50 反弹带减仓, $3.30 视为最后投降位, 破位对标 $3。
